text: Monday. Headache started around 3pm behind my eyes, 6/10. Been on spreadsheets since 9 with barely a break. Slept maybe 6.5h. Didnt take anything, just drank water.

Rough day. Woke up already with a dull head and by afternoon it was a 7/10, pounding on the left side. Only slept 5 hours, couldnt switch my brain off. 3 video calls back to back. Took an ibuprofen at 4pm, helped a bit.
Better today, like a 4. Slept 7h. Went outside at lunch which maybe helped?? No pills.
Headache came back after lunch, about 5/10. Screen all afternoon again and my eyes feel dry. 6.5h sleep. Took ibuprofen around 5.
Friday. 6/10 from like 2pm. Slept about 6h. Took one ibuprofen, then gave up on the laptop at 5 and it eased off.
Saturday. Tiny twinge when I woke up, 1/10, gone by noon. Slept almost 9 hours. No phone till 10.
Sunday. Nothing at all. Long walk and cooked a proper dinner. Slept 8h.
Monday again. Dull headache from the afternoon, 5/10. Quarterly figures all day, almost no breaks. Slept 7h. Didnt take anything.

Terrible one today, 8/10 and I felt sick to my stomach for a while. Only slept around 4.5h, was up late finishing a report. Back to back video calls and those bright office lights. Took ibuprofen at noon, barely helped.
Still bad, 7/10. Slept 5.5h. Around 1pm my vision went blurry for maybe 5 minutes, then back to normal. Never had that before, probably the screens? Took ibuprofen.
Calmer day, 4/10. Slept 7h. Long lunch outside and only one coffee. No pills.
5/10 in the afternoon. Slept 6.5h. Took ibuprofen at 4. Friday calls just dragged on.
Halloween at a friends place. Small twinge in the morning (1/10), nothing after that. Slept 8h.
Sunday. No headache. Slept 9h, did laundry and read most of the day.
Mon. 6/10 starting around 2, tight band across my forehead. Slept about 6h. 9 hours at the desk straight. Pushed through, no pills.
Bad one, 7/10 even though I slept ok (7h). Skipped lunch because of a deadline and had 3 coffees. Lay in a dark room for 20 min. Took ibuprofen.
8/10 today, the roughest of the week. Only 5h sleep again, was up past 1am. Light bothered me and the screen made it worse. Took ibuprofen at 11 and it barely did anything.
6/10. Slept about 6h. Took ibuprofen again at lunch.
5/10 in the afternoon. Slept 6.5h. Tried water and a walk instead of pills, it eased up after an hour.
Mild headache when I got up, 2/10, gone after breakfast. Slept 8h.
Sunday, no headache. Slept 8.5h. Stayed offline all day. Dreading the screens tomorrow tbh.
